name: supabase
description: Build fullstack applications with Supabase's Postgres database, authentication, storage, and real-time subscriptions. Ports the Supabase Hosted Kiro Power to Kiro Crew, and adds a page that lists your Supabase organizations and projects.
author: nadetastic
highlights: Connects to the hosted Supabase MCP server at mcp.supabase.com
A Supabase page with Sign in with Supabase that lists your organizations, projects and public tables
A Supabase agent that reads the right guide before it touches your database
Guides for SQL style, migrations, RLS policies, Postgres functions, Edge Functions, Next.js auth and Realtime
